note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 (independent auditor, authored none of 32ff59085b). Section 3.1.3: "If the AFI is IPv4, then the maximum value of the Prefix Length field is 32. If the AFI is IPv6, then the maximum value of the Prefix Length field is 128." 32ff59085b made the T1ST Source Address Length octet mandatory, matching Section 3.1.3.1 ("The Source Address Length has a fixed length of 1 octet." and the TLV remainder counted from "the offset of the end of the Source Address"); parseBodyT1ST now returns ErrMUPTruncated when nothing follows the endpoint. Positive T1ST IPv4 prefix length 33 now closes with endpoint4NoSource, so the prefix bound is the only fault and the route is withdrawn exactly; negative prefix 32 kept, now with its mandatory zero source length. The IPv6 128 clause has no T1ST case in the tagged units: parseBodyT1ST calls the shared AFI-indexed m.parsePrefixField, whose IPv6 bound the ISD 128/129 cases pin; a T1ST-only regression of that clause would stay green here, as the 2026-10-14 judgement already noted. Both revert records were re-taken today with ./le rfc discriminate-record over HEAD and observed red naming the unit.
